A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose to use a learned hierarchical feature matching cost, which is combined with the intensity matching cost in the energy function and the regularization is performed using the IGMRF and sparsity priros.
we propose a novel approach to learn hierarchical features from stereo pairs in an unsupervise manner and we use them for dense disparity estimation.
we have proposed a new dense stereo matching framework which uses the learned hierarchical features and the sparsity and IGMRF regularization for dense disparity estimation.

the learned features from the deep convolutional neural network can be used for dense disparity estimation.
the learned hierarchical features are more discriminative than the handcrafted features and they can be used for disparity estimation in an unsupervized way.
we show that it is possible to learn the features for stereo matching in an unsupervized manner and the learned features are effective in dense disparity estimation.
